bug_info.bug_desc: When the Hypervisor extension is enabled, a trap targeting supervisor mode but not virtual supervisor mode (trap_to_priv_lvl == S and trap_to_v == 0) is skipped by the supervisor-trap update logic. The nested RVH/trap_to_v conditional only executes the VS trap path when trap_to_v is asserted, while the ordinary S/HS trap path is placed in the else branch of the RVH check and is therefore unreachable when RVH is enabled. As a result, the supervisor trap state such as status, cause, epc, and tval is not updated correctly for non-virtualized S-mode traps.
bug_info.fix_hint: Restructure the trap-to-supervisor conditional so that the VS trap update path is selected only when RVH is enabled and trap_to_v is asserted. For traps targeting supervisor mode with trap_to_v deasserted, allow the ordinary supervisor trap update path to execute even when RVH is enabled.
